clue.text: Doctor's promise to a top rich chap I injured

indicators.note: something injured is knocked out of shape, so the six words before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor makes a vow to a wealthy patient whom he has somehow hurt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'injured' signals that TO A TOP RICH CHAP I is rearranged into the fifteen letters of the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient oath sworn by physicians is the classic medical pledge of ethical conduct.

clue.text: Falconer's pet subject?

parts.note: a favourite pastime or pet subject shares its name with a small falcon that a falconer might keep

explanation.definitionFit: A pastime pursued for pleasure is one's pet subject, and the same word names a small falcon.

clue.text: Spread to support an entrance

parts.note: a prop is a support
an gives the single letter A
a gate is an entrance

explanation.surface: A request to spread something so as to hold up a doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: To spread ideas or plants is to multiply and disseminate them.

clue.text: Finished on top

definitions.meaning: a match that is done and ended
above, as a blanket lies above a sheet

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both concluded and positioned above something.

clue.text: Can be mounted, using a bridle

indicators.note: using the letters means working them into a new arrangement, so a bridle is reshuffled

explanation.surface: A horse that will take a rider once a bridle is put on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'using' is the signal to rearrange the letters of A BRIDLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fit to be ridden, like a quiet horse, can be mounted.

clue.text: Venetian painter's connection with sport

definitions.note: the 's stands for is: the painter is the following charade

parts.note: a tie is a connection or bond
polo is a sport played on horseback

explanation.surface: Some link between an Italian artist and athletics.
explanation.walkthrough: Giambattista Tiepolo was an eighteenth-century Venetian painter of grand frescoes.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiepolo is a famous eighteenth-century fresco artist from Venice.

clue.text: Rissole made chiefly of game

parts.note: the fried patty's name is mostly the name of the mallet-and-hoop lawn game, with a short ending added

explanation.walkthrough: 'game' suggests venison or pheasant in the rissole, but it is the lawn game played with mallets and hoops whose name forms most of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: A breadcrumbed fried cake of minced food is a kind of rissole.

clue.text: Excuse to hold a party is first class

indicators.note: the first-class term is set to hold the party within it

parts.note: A1 means first class, written AI
Lib is short for the Liberal party

explanation.surface: Throwing a party gives a top-notch excuse.
explanation.walkthrough: A1 (first class) is written with the letter I for the one; LIB is the Liberal party.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim of being elsewhere is a standard excuse offered to avoid blame.

clue.text: Chap is occupying shelter those interested in his welfare provided

indicators.note: the chap and 'is' occupy the shelter, sitting inside it

parts.note: huts are shelters
a chap is a man

explanation.surface: A man stays in a shelter that has been provided by people who care for him.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shelter' must be read as a plural, huts; 'his' in the definition points back to the chap, meaning mankind's welfare.
explanation.definitionFit: Those devoted to human welfare and values rather than the divine are humanitarian thinkers.

clue.text: Literary prop?

parts.note: not a supporter of literature but a physical support that keeps a row of volumes upright

explanation.definitionFit: A shelf support that stops books falling over is literally a prop for literature.

clue.text: Sounds like an eye specialist's self diagnosis

definitions.text: Sounds like an eye specialist's self diagnosis

parts.words: Sounds like an eye specialist's self diagnosis
parts.note: an eye specialist sounds like an 'I' specialist, someone fixated on the self

explanation.definitionFit: Excessive preoccupation with oneself is the vice of thinking always of 'I'.

clue.text: Affirmative vote right for this period of time

parts.note: yea is a vote of yes

explanation.surface: Voting yes for the right timescale.
explanation.definitionFit: Twelve months is a standard period of time.

clue.text: Forgiveness for sailor with an answer

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor
a solution is an answer

explanation.surface: A sailor seeks pardon, and is given an answer.
explanation.walkthrough: AB (able seaman) is the usual crossword sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal release from sin, as granted by a priest, is a kind of pardon.

clue.text: Large — if shifted, easily broken

indicators.note: the letters of large and if are shifted around into a new order

explanation.surface: A big object, if moved, may break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shifted' suggests moving furniture, but it signals rearranging LARGE IF.
explanation.definitionFit: Something delicate or brittle breaks easily.

clue.text: Fair realm upset by warning of conflagration

indicators.note: upset means overturned or disordered, so fair realm is rearranged

explanation.surface: A fair kingdom is thrown into turmoil by news of a great fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' signals that the letters of FAIR REALM are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell or siren that sounds when a blaze breaks out warns of the fire.

clue.text: Gate-crash and peer into mess without initial licence

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the mixed letters go round the licence's initial
a mess is a jumble, so peer into is jumbled
the initial of licence is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone crashes a party and peers into the mess hall without a pass.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mess' scrambles the eight letters to INTEROPE, and 'without' in its old sense of outside wraps them round L.
explanation.definitionFit: To intrude where one is not wanted is to crash uninvited.

clue.text: Armed hazard for snorkellers

parts.note: armed not with weapons but with eight limbs, a sea creature a swimmer might meet

explanation.definitionFit: The eight-armed sea creature is a hazard a swimmer could meet underwater.

clue.text: Scent coming from tail-pouch

indicators.note: the letters come from tail-pouch, made over into a new order

explanation.surface: A smell comes out of an animal's pouch.
explanation.definitionFit: The heavy oil from an Asian plant is used as a perfume.

clue.text: Once again submit, though not to a superior force

definitions.text: Once again submit, though not to a superior force

parts.words: Once again submit, though not to a superior force
parts.note: submit in the sense of hand in a form or entry, done a second time, not yielding to a stronger power

explanation.definitionFit: To go in or put in one's name a second time is to come back in again.

clue.text: Planting pea roughly in circle — it's farm work

indicators.note: planting puts the mixed letters into the ring
in places the scrambled letters within the circle

parts.note: a ring is a circle

indicators.note: roughly means approximately arranged, so pea is rearranged

explanation.surface: Peas being sown in a circular plot as part of the farmer's job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'roughly' makes EAP; 'Planting' and 'in' together say it goes within the circle.
explanation.definitionFit: Cutting and gathering crops at harvest is a farm task.

clue.text: Open air?

parts.note: not outdoors but an open, frank manner or bearing

explanation.definitionFit: Frankness is an open manner, an air of honesty.

clue.text: Exalted clergyman as redeemer

indicators.note: exalted means raised up, and in a down entry raising reads the letters upwards

parts.note: Rev, Reverend, is a clergyman

explanation.surface: A senior churchman acting as a saviour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Exalted' (raised up) reverses REV AS in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: One who redeems is one who rescues or delivers.

clue.text: Fellow with skin affliction

definitions.meaning: a fellow is a man or guy
a crack or roughness of the skin caused by cold

explanation.surface: A man with a rash.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a bloke and a cold-induced crack in the skin.

clue.text: After parking I go on trail of stray animal

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow on their trail

explanation.surface: After leaving the car I follow the tracks of a lost beast.
explanation.walkthrough: A pi-dog (pye-dog) is a stray ownerless dog of Asian villages.
explanation.definitionFit: A half-wild ownerless dog of India and the East is a stray.

clue.text: River bird

definitions.meaning: a river in the English Midlands

explanation.surface: A bird by the water.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names an English river and a pigeon-like bird.

clue.text: A student I love turning out to be the pits

parts.note: L, the learner plate, stands for a student

indicators.note: turning out means being turned inside out, so I love is rearranged

explanation.surface: A student declares love for something that proves to be dreadful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning out' rearranges I LOVE into VEOLI; L is the learner-driver's letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Tiny air sacs in the lungs are small cavities or pits.

clue.text: Ring of circular shape is booming

parts.note: a ring is shaped like the letter O
rotund means round in shape

explanation.surface: A round ring makes a loud resonant sound.
explanation.definitionFit: A full, resonant voice is a deep and loud one.

clue.text: Arranging merger and taking over this growing business

indicators.note: arranging the letters puts merger and taking into a new order

explanation.surface: Organising a corporate merger and takeover of a horticultural firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Arranging' rearranges MERGER AND TAKING; 'over' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising vegetables for sale is a business that grows produce.
